sections.Profile:
"Rocket" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Company in November 1959. Designed by Harry Williams, the game features a space exploration theme, capturing the excitement of the late 1950s space race.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1959
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Space, Original Theme, Rockets, Single level playfield
